tasks.title: Create database layer (database.py)
tasks.description: Create backend/app/database.py with SQLAlchemy engine configuration, SessionLocal factory, and Base declarative base. Use sqlite:///./bookmarks.db as the default database URL. Provide a get_db dependency generator for FastAPI dependency injection.
acceptanceCriteria: backend/app/database.py exists
SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URL is set to sqlite:///./bookmarks.db
Engine is created with connect_args={'check_same_thread': False} for SQLite
SessionLocal is a configured sessionmaker bound to the engine
Base is a declarative_base() instance
get_db() generator yields a session and closes it in finally block

tasks.title: Create ORM models (models.py)
tasks.description: Create backend/app/models.py with Bookmark model, Tag model, and bookmark_tags association table. Bookmark has id, url (unique), title, created_at, updated_at. Tag has id, name (unique). bookmark_tags is a many-to-many association with composite primary key (bookmark_id, tag_id).
acceptanceCriteria: backend/app/models.py exists
Bookmark model has columns: id (PK), url (unique, not null), title (not null), created_at (server default), updated_at (server default)
Tag model has columns: id (PK), name (unique, not null)
bookmark_tags association table has bookmark_id (FK) and tag_id (FK) with composite PK
Bookmark has a 'tags' relationship to Tag via bookmark_tags
All models inherit from Base imported from database.py

tasks.title: Create Pydantic schemas (schemas.py)
tasks.description: Create backend/app/schemas.py with BookmarkCreate (request) and BookmarkResponse (response) Pydantic models. BookmarkCreate has url (str, required), title (str, required), tags (list[str], optional, default []). BookmarkResponse has id, url, title, tags (list[str]), created_at, updated_at with model_config for from_attributes.
acceptanceCriteria: backend/app/schemas.py exists
BookmarkCreate schema validates url (required str), title (required str), tags (optional list[str] defaulting to [])
BookmarkResponse schema includes id, url, title, tags as list[str], created_at (datetime), updated_at (datetime)
BookmarkResponse has model_config with from_attributes=True for ORM compatibility

tasks.title: Create bookmarks router with POST endpoint
tasks.description: Create backend/app/routers/__init__.py and backend/app/routers/bookmarks.py. Implement POST /api/bookmarks endpoint that: creates a bookmark with url, title, and optional tags; uses get-or-create logic for tags (FR7, normalize tag names to lowercase/stripped); returns 201 with BookmarkResponse on success; returns 409 with detail message on duplicate URL (AC1.3); returns 422 automatically via Pydantic for missing required fields (AC1.4).
acceptanceCriteria: backend/app/routers/__init__.py exists
backend/app/routers/bookmarks.py exists with APIRouter
POST /api/bookmarks creates a bookmark and returns 201 with BookmarkResponse body
Tags are get-or-created: existing tags are reused, new tags are created (FR7)
Tag names are normalized (lowercase, stripped) to prevent near-duplicates
Duplicate URL returns 409 with {"detail": "A bookmark with this URL already exists"}
Missing url or title returns 422 validation error (handled by FastAPI/Pydantic)
Bookmark created without tags returns empty tags list (AC1.2)

tasks.title: Wire up router and DB init in main.py

acceptanceCriteria: main.py imports and includes the bookmarks router
Database tables are created on application startup (Base.metadata.create_all)
